items.title: ‘Charges Could Come Soon’: Kalshi Reportedly Faces CFTC Action Over Alleged Failure to Notify New Contracts
items.summary: Kalshi faces potential charges from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission after the regulator reportedly questioned on Tuesday whether the prediction-market platform notified it about dozens of new contracts. Trouble for Kalshi? The CFTC warned Kalshi that “charges could ​come soon,” Reuters reported, citing a person familiar with the matter. The regulator didn’t immediately return Benzinga’s request for comment. A response from Kalshi is also awaited. Read Also: Can Bitcoin Hold $70,000 Ahea

items.title: Coinbase Gets National Bank Charter Approval
items.summary: Bloomberg's Olga Kharif joins Isabelle Lee and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Coinbase, the largest US crypto exchange, said a key regulator has fully signed off on its request to become a nationally chartered trust bank, the latest example of firms in the digital-asset space entering the world of traditional finance.
